content.text: What happened to order 4411? Look it up.
What happened to order 4412? Look it up. Before you do, work out in your head which is larger, 17 * 23 + 19 * 31 or 29 * 29 + 11 * 13, and say which with your answer.
Say in one sentence what happened to both orders. Look nothing up.
